sections.Description:
For the first time ever, players will explore, discover, and unlock the secrets of the Black Knight universe

Navigating through these dark, mysterious, and twisted realms, players will uncover foes, demons, riches, and secrets in their quest against the Black Knight.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- Battle the Black Knight: The interactive Black Knight toy features a bi-directional motorized flail, a glowing RGB helmet with individually controllable expressive lighting to interact and taunt players with custom speech, and a sliding coil-driven shield that will bash and block your shots.
- Load the Catapult: Enter Lexan Upper Playfield from the Castle VUK, launching the ball from the lower to upper playfield. Featuring a full sized flipper, orbit lane, target and 3-ball Catapult Multiball lock mechanism.
- Use the Magna Save: Featuring the distinct “Magna-Save”, a player-controlled magnet used to prevent a ball from draining. Harness the power using the Action Button on the lockdown bar.
sections.Editions:
Pro:
- Spectacular Video Art and Animation that thrills players as they meet the Black Knight.
- Featuring Black Knight’s original voice from Steve Ritchie and music composed & performed by Scott Ian of ANTHRAX.
- Exclusive ‘Castle’ full color high definition art on backglass and cabinet by Kevin O’Connor.

Premium:
- Powder-coated steel bottom arch with black wrinkle finish side armor, hinges and front lockdown bar.
- Featuring Black Knight’s original voice from Steve Ritchie and music composed & performed by Scott Ian of ANTHRAX.
- Exclusive ‘Swordsman’ full color high definition art on backglass and cabinet by Kevin O’Connor.

Limited Edition:
- Gloss Black & Gold Metal flake side armor, legs, backbox hinges and Gold leg bolts.
- High definition speak system with 3-channel amplifier.
- Exclusive ‘Battlefield’ hand-drawn full color high definition art on backglass and cabinet decals by Kevin O’Connor.
